segments.text: His Wish: "The Hope from childhood, to realize any wish, should return."
Function: The wish of an unrelated person is fullfilled.
- Ability to create new "Tools", but only when the person has never been in contact with other "Tools" before
"I said it thrice, so it must be true! Uhahaha!"
# Forces the will off the user upon everyone in hearing range, after the bell rings three times.
# Obviously, if you close off your ears (or are the user) you are not affected by it.
The Leader of the Group who is the same age as Kou. She met the group 8 years ago, but was forced to leave them because of her family's habit of moving around a lot.
Function: Ability to set any target into a deep slumber.

8 years ago, Riko was added as one of the adventure group's members, and was given the nickname "Iriko" by Urara. Because her mother is sick, she has to take care of her two younger siblings. The smallest of the group, but at the same time the most mother-like. For obscure reasons everyone fears her "punishments".

Kou's childhood friend who is 5 years older than him, she is often called "Yae-nee" and considered everybody's older sister. She loves birds, especially watching and eating them. She also loves traveling around with her motorcycle.
Unknown; Probably smt. like "I want to know everything"
# Collects information about the targeted object
Can't read the mood even for the sake of her life. She makes emotionless scientific statements in all situations, appropriate or not. But knows almost everything, which matches her tool.
"The Gold of the World is changed at my Hand."
Foresee the desire of the partner

If it can be bought, Maki is your (wo)man. Likes to show off her wealth, and her pride is higher than any mountain to the point where she easily becomes rivals with almost anybody. During her childhood, she was a modest girl, but had grown into a total princess later, and this fact shocks Kou.
# 『楽になりたい』= I want to feel relieved
# Pushes all negative feelings to the touched person
Doesn't speaks much. Has a beautiful fingernail, that she tries to protect.
# Rewinds the time of an person (except Conscience).
# This includes any object the Person is wearing or carrying.
Hates the fate of time because it rots all beauty.
You can't be sure if he is on your side or not, but he stays true to a promise even if given to the greatest enemy.
The bonnet is a memento of his actress mother, who lost her job due to aging, which resulted in his wish and lifestyle.
#『苦しみを忘れてしまいたい』= I want to forget the suffering
#『イェンダーの魔除け』= Amulet of Yenda
#『苦痛を消してしまう』= The Pain is erased
Had a lover who commited suicide, which resulted in her wish
